div.head: Norðleoda 7.1
div.ab: 7 gif he ne geþeo butan to healfre hide, þonne sy his wergyld LXXX scll'.
Et si non assurgat nisi ad dimidiam hidam, tunc sit wera eius (id est soluendi pretium) LXXX sol.
And gif he ne geþeo buton to healfre hide, þonne si his wer LXXX scill'.
And if he does not prosper beyond half a hide, then his wergild is to be 80 shillings.
And if he does not prosper to more than half a hide, then his wergild will be eighty shillings.
Und (Aber Ld) wenn er nur zu ½ Hid kommt (gestiegen ist lq), dann sei sein Wergeld 80 Schill.
And (But, Ld) if he only attains to ½ hide (has risen, lq), then let his wergild be 80 shillings.
div.note: Ld's ‘healfhyda’ occurs only here. Liebermann compares Ine 32.
